selected_prompts.macro_domain: Narrative & Cinematic Storytelling (叙事与影视创作)
selected_prompts.micro_domain: Suspense and Discovery Moments (悬念与发现时刻)
selected_prompts.prompt: Shoot a suspenseful museum corridor scene at closing time. A security guard with a flashlight and a curator holding a tablet stop before an ancient portrait. The guard notices a faint draft, presses a hidden latch in the frame, and the painting swings open to reveal a narrow passage. As the air rushes out, the hallway lights flicker and the curator's tablet screen glitches, forcing them to step back in alarm.
